title: DFT total energy calculations for fcc actinides
action: Perform self-consistent LSDA+CPA calculations for each actinide (Th, Pa, U, Np, Pu, Am, Cm, Bk) in the fcc crystal structure, for a set of volumes spanning roughly ±10% around the expected equilibrium, using an open-source KKR or LMTO-based code with CPA capability (e.g., SPR-KKR). For Pu, the DLM (disordered local moment) setup must be used. Record total energies and self-consistent potentials for each volume.

title: Extract equilibrium Wigner-Seitz radius and bulk modulus
action: For each actinide, fit the total energy vs. volume data from the DFT calculations to an equation of state (e.g., Birch-Murnaghan) and extract the equilibrium Wigner-Seitz radius (in Bohr) and bulk modulus (in GPa). Compile the results into a CSV file.
description: CSV file with columns: element (string), rws_bohr (float, Wigner-Seitz radius in Bohr), bulk_modulus_gpa (float, bulk modulus in GPa). One row per element (Th, Pa, U, Np, Pu, Am, Cm, Bk).

title: Compute density of states for δ-Pu
action: Using the self-consistent potential from the Pu DFT calculation at the equilibrium volume, compute the electronic density of states (DOS) as a function of energy. Output a two-column CSV of energy (eV) relative to the Fermi level and DOS (states/eV/atom).
description: CSV file with columns: energy_eV (float, energy relative to Fermi level in eV), dos_states_per_eV_atom (float, density of states in states/eV/atom).
